# CXNM - Standard - WIN - U - Compliance OS Version

Checks whether the device runs a Windows version that can actually apply the baseline: at least Windows 11 22H2.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Compliance |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Own policy; the minimum follows from what the baseline itself already requires — Account Lockout needs 22H2 with KB5053657 or 24H2, Administrator Protection and Windows Protected Print need 24H2 |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_U_Compliance_OS_Version.json`](Baseline_WIN_U_Compliance_OS_Version.json) |

> **This value goes out of date and must be reviewed.** 10.0.22621 is Windows 11 22H2. Run `node scripts/check-osversion.js` to see how far it lags behind the n-1 version from endoflife.date; that report deliberately blocks nothing, because as soon as an outdated minimum turns the build red, someone raises the number to make it green. Raising it is a decision and therefore a PR — this minimum is a capability floor (see `ondergrens`), so letting it move along automatically with n-1 would remove precisely the reason it is set to 22H2.
